basic_details.short_information: Raman Research Institute (RRI), Bengaluru has invited applications for one regular post of Assistant Administrative Officer I (Pay Level 10, 7th CPC), to be filled purely on deputation basis from eligible Indian nationals. content_sections.heading: About RRI
content_sections.text: The Raman Research Institute is described in the notice as a premier institute engaged in research in basic sciences, funded by the Government of India, Department of Science and Technology. It is located in Bengaluru. This post is a vacant regular post that the Institute proposes to fill purely through deputation.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application in a sealed cover, with the post applied for written on the envelope, to: The Director, Raman Research Institute, C.V. Raman Avenue, Sadashivanagar, Benguluru – 560080. The notice does not name a postal mode or an email address for applications. The application must be made on the Application Format printed with the notice, which has a space for a passport size photograph. The notice also asks that the application be submitted through proper channel; without it, the applicant will not be allowed to appear for interview. Applications received after the last date will not be considered. Fill in the Application Format given in the notice and paste a passport size photograph on it. Have the employer / Cadre Controlling Authority certification on the form completed. Attach the enclosures listed below and the list of enclosures. Seal the application in a cover and write the post applied for on it. Address the cover to the Director at the address above so that it reaches by 31 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university. The candidate must also be an official of a Central Govt. Office / State Govt. Office / University / Recognized Research Institute / Semi-Govt., Statutory / Central Autonomous Body. The official must satisfy one of the following: Holding an analogous post; or With 2 years of regular service in Pay Level-9; or With 4 years of regular service in Pay Level-8; or With 5 years of regular service in Pay Level-7. Maximum age limit is 56 years as on the closing date of application. The notice prints no age relaxation and no minimum age. The date of birth entered in the form and recorded in the Matriculation / Secondary Examination Certificate / Birth Certificate will be accepted for determining age, and no later request for change will be considered or granted. The candidate must be a citizen of India. The prescribed qualifications are the minimum required, and possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Deputation
content_sections.text: The post is a vacant regular post to be filled purely on deputation basis. The initial period of deputation shall be 2 years. The terms of deputation will be governed by DOPT OM No. 6/8/2009 – Estt (Pay II) DTD 17.06.2010 as amended from time to time. During the period of service, every employee will be covered under CCS (Conduct) Rules and CCS (CCA) Rules etc.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The Application Format and its employer certification name the following items: Passport size photograph pasted on the application format. Employer / Cadre Controlling Authority certification, signed with name, designation, telephone number and office seal. CR dossier in original, or photocopies of the ACRs for the last 5 years duly attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary of the Govt. of India or above or equivalent. A list of major / minor penalties imposed during the last 10 years, if any were imposed. A separate authenticated sheet for employment details or additional information, if the space in the form is insufficient. The list of enclosures given at the end of the form. The form asks for name and address, post applied for, date of birth, date of superannuation, status of present employer, initial date of appointment in Govt. service, office and residential addresses, present post with Pay Level and basic pay, educational qualifications, employment details, nature of present employment, deputation / contract details, total emoluments per month, additional information and a brief statement of suitability. The employer's certificate says there is no vigilance or disciplinary case pending against the applicant, that integrity is certified, and that the Cadre Controlling Authority has no objection to the applicant being considered on deputation basis.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The method of selection is Personal Interview. Call letters for the interview will be sent only by e-mail, so candidates must check their registered mail frequently. Candidates who appear for interview will be paid an amount equivalent to 2nd A/C train fare by shortest route or actual, whichever is less, from their place of residence to Bangalore. The notice does not give an interview date or venue. The details filled in the application form will be verified before the results are published. If a candidate fails to give authentic proof for the details, the candidature will be summarily forfeited.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Assistant Administrative Officer I, filled purely on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the RRI Assistant Administrative Officer I post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of application is 31 Dec 2026, and applications received after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the RRI Assistant Administrative Officer I post?
faq.answer: A graduate in any discipline from a recognized university who is an official of a Central or State Govt. office, university, recognized research institute, or semi-Govt., statutory or central autonomous body, holding an analogous post or with 2 years in Pay Level-9, 4 years in Pay Level-8 or 5 years in Pay Level-7 of regular service.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the RRI deputation post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 56 years as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay level of the RRI Assistant Administrative Officer I post?
faq.answer: The pay is Pay Level 10 as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for RRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the application in a sealed cover, with the post applied for written on the envelope, to the Director, Raman Research Institute, C.V. Raman Avenue, Sadashivanagar, Benguluru – 560080, through proper channel.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the RRI post?
faq.answer: The method of selection is Personal Interview, and call letters will be sent only by e-mail.

faq.question: Q8. Is the RRI Assistant Administrative Officer I post permanent?
faq.answer: It is a vacant regular post filled purely on deputation basis, and the initial period of deputation shall be 2 years.

faq.question: Q9. Will interview candidates get travel expenses?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who appear for interview will be paid an amount equivalent to 2nd A/C train fare by shortest route or actual, whichever is less, from their place of residence to Bangalore.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for the RRI deputation post?
faq.answer: Only citizens of India who are officials of the Central Govt., State Govt., university, recognized research institute, or semi-Govt., statutory or central autonomous body, and who meet the experience conditions, can apply.
